options.name: after_login_url
options.description: URL of the page to redirect the user to after logging in.

options.name: autologin
options.description: Whether to enable auto-login. If enable autologin, cannot enable autologout.

options.name: autologout
options.description: User session life time in seconds. If set to 0, the session will never expire. If enable autologout, cannot enable autologin.

options.name: current_passwd
options.description: Current password for the user when overriding its password. Required when overriding the logged in user's password. https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/6.4/en/manual/api/reference/user/update

options.name: http_login_password
options.description: Basic Auth password

options.name: http_login_user
options.description: Basic Auth login

options.name: lang
options.description: Language code of the user's language.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the user.

options.name: override_passwd
options.description: Override password for the user. Password will not be updated on subsequent runs without setting this value to yes.

options.name: passwd
options.description: User's password. Required unless all of the I(usrgrps) are set to use LDAP as frontend access.

options.name: refresh
options.description: Automatic refresh period in seconds.

options.name: role_name
options.description: User's role. Default is C(User role) when creating a new user. The default value will be removed at the version 2.0.0.

options.name: rows_per_page
options.description: Amount of object rows to show per page.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the user. On C(present), it will create if user does not exist or update the user if the associated data is different. On C(absent) will remove a user if it exists.

options.name: surname
options.description: Surname of the user.

options.name: theme
options.description: User's theme.

options.name: timezone
options.description: User's time zone. For the full list of supported time zones please refer to U(https://www.php.net/manual/en/timezones.php)

options.name: user_medias
options.description: Set the user's media. If not set, makes no changes to media.

options.name: username
options.description: Username. username is the unique identifier used and cannot be updated using this module.

options.name: usrgrps
options.description: User groups to add the user to. Required when I(state=present).
